note: The Launcher is enabled in 999 only while every entry REQUIRED for the launch mode being run is present. The preflight derives enabled_in_999 from registration.json plus this check; this manifest writes nothing outside this skill. A skill_tree entry carries min_version, read from that tree's skill-version.txt; dispatch and assemble run this check first and refuse on any required entry that is missing or below its minimum.

closure.note: The entries below are the TRANSITIVE closure the launcher really loads, not one row per skill: code, schemas, role/prompt templates, brand rules, shared packages, provider helpers and the Command Center contract. `class` says how an entry is selected: `required` blocks every mode; `selected_conditional` blocks only the modes it names in `modes` (an entry with no `modes` applies to all of them); `unselected_optional` is reported and never blocks. `required` stays for the v1 readers that only know that field.

modes.plan: intake -> route graph -> the plan hash a client approves (no page is built)
modes.questions: the shared guided interview; reads the question bank only
modes.dispatch: build every page with the stub image provider (a practice run spends nothing)
modes.dispatch-kie: build every page with the paid KIE transport (transport, receipts, image prompt helpers)
modes.assemble: package the built pages and validate the delivery
